notes: Deliberate off-by-one: end = start + pageSize - 1 (should be start + pageSize). paginate.test.ts encodes the intended behavior.

notes: Symptom surfaces via repo.list -> paginate, but root cause is the slice end in paginate(). Tests the agent following the call chain to the leaf bug, not stopping at the handler.
